butterfly
:::
::: {.card-body}
An R package for the verification of continually updating timeseries data where we expect new values, but want to ensure previous data remains unchanged.

<a href="https://thomaszwagerman.github.io/butterfly/"><img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thomaszwagerman/butterfly/refs/heads/main/inst/figures/logo.png" align="centre" height="139" alt="butterfly website" /></a>

:::: {.card}
::: {.card-header}
asli-pipeline
:::
::: {.card-body}
A pipeline for operational execution of the Amundsen Sea Ice Low calculations, provided in the asli package. The functions in the asli package are described in detail in the package repository amundsen-sea-low-index.

<a href="https://github.com/antarctica/asli-pipeline/"><img src="https://scotthosking.com/assets/images/asl_index-crop3.png" align="centre" height="139" alt="asli-pipeline website" /></a>

[View Project](https://github.com/antarctica/asli-pipeline){.btn .btn-primary}
:::
